title: Fullstack Digital Marketing Manager - Performance, CRM & SEO
description_text:
IBMC is assisting a fast-paced, high-growth digital marketing and growth agency. Our client specializes in delivering data-driven performance, CRM, and organic growth strategies for enterprise clients across global markets, with deep expertise in financial services, proprietary trading, hedge funds, and fintech. We are seeking a results-driven Fullstack Digital Marketing Manager to lead our Growth Marketing division.
We are seeking an analytical, strategic, and hands-on Fullstack Digital Marketing Manager to lead our cross-functional Growth Marketing team spanning Performance Advertising (Meta & Google Ads), CRM/Email Marketing, and SEO. In this high-ownership leadership role, you will develop and execute full-funnel digital growth strategies, optimize multi-channel budgets, and drive measurable ROI, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), and Lifetime Value (LTV). You will serve as the strategic bridge between performance execution, creative production, and executive reporting.

Key Responsibilities
- Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead, mentor, and manage specialists across Performance Ads, CRM, and SEO, fostering a high-performing, collaborative agency environment.
- Full-Funnel Growth Strategy: Develop and execute integrated strategies across Meta Ads, Google Ads, lifecycle email marketing/automations, and organic SEO content to maximize full-funnel conversion efficiency.
- Performance & Paid Media Oversight: Direct campaign setup, media planning, audience targeting, and real-time optimization with a strict focus on ROI, CAC, and conversion metrics.
- CRM & Lifecycle Architecture: Guide the CRM specialist in building customer journeys, automated drip workflows, segmentation, and retention campaigns (e.g., Klaviyo/Mailchimp).
- SEO & Content Direction: Oversee SEO technical audits, keyword strategies, and content pipelines to drive sustainable organic traffic acquisition.
- Budget & ROI Management: Manage multi-channel digital marketing budgets, ensuring optimal capital allocation across paid platforms.
- Analytics & Performance Reporting: Own the reporting pipeline; analyze web analytics (GA4), ad platform data, and market trends to deliver actionable insights and executive dashboards.
- Creative & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Direct the development of performance-driven creative briefs, collaborating closely with video, design, web development, sales, and PR teams to deliver high-converting assets on tight deadlines.

Requirements:
- Experience: Minimum 5 years of digital marketing experience, with at least 2 years in a direct managerial or team leadership role.
- Domain Expertise: Proven hands-on track record across Performance Advertising (Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads), CRM/Email Marketing, and SEO (Ahrefs, SEMrush).
- Industry Background: Direct experience in a fast-paced, high-pressure Agency environment, preferably with exposure to clients in Financial Services, Proprietary Trading, Hedge Funds, or Fintech.
- Analytical Proficiency: Strong mastery of marketing analytics tools (Google Analytics/GA4, Meta Ads Manager, CRM automation platforms).
- Full-Funnel Lifecycle Knowledge: Deep understanding of customer lifecycle marketing, retention funnels, performance scaling, and attribution models.
- Creative Direction: Sharp creative eye with experience partnering with videographers and graphic designers to produce high-performing ad creatives.
- Language Skills: Fluent in English (both written and spoken) for executive stakeholder reporting and international team collaboration.

title: Fullstack Digital Marketing Manager
description_text:
IBMC is a Business Management Consulting firm that connects global companies with top-tier talent. We are currently assisting our sister company a high-growth international marketing agency specializing in the financial services, fintech, and proprietary trading sectors in hiring a strategic Fullstack Digital Marketing Manager. Our agency serves 100% international clients, delivering performance-driven growth on a global scale.
We are looking for a powerhouse Fullstack Digital Marketing Manager to lead our Growth Marketing team. In this pivotal role, you will oversee specialists across Performance Ads, CRM, and SEO, driving integrated full-funnel strategies. You are not just a manager but a growth architect who understands how to bridge the gap between paid media, organic search, and lifecycle retention to maximize ROI and lower CAC.

Key Responsibilities
- Team Leadership: Mentor and manage a high-performing team of specialists (Ads, CRM, SEO), fostering a collaborative and results-oriented environment.
- Full-Funnel Strategy: Develop and execute integrated digital marketing strategies across Meta, Google Ads, Email/CRM journeys, and SEO content frameworks.
- Performance Oversight: Direct the Performance Ads team in campaign architecture, high-budget optimization, and rigorous tracking to ensure maximum ROI and efficient CAC.
- Lifecycle Marketing: Guide the CRM specialist in building sophisticated customer journeys, automation workflows, and advanced segmentation.
- Data-Driven Reporting: Own the digital marketing reporting process, translating complex multi-channel data into actionable growth insights for stakeholders.
- Budget & Media Planning: Manage significant digital marketing budgets across all platforms, ensuring optimal allocation and performance.
- Creative Collaboration: Lead the development of high-impact creative briefs, partnering with design and video teams to produce performance-first assets.
- Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with Web Development, Sales, Media, and PR teams to ensure a unified and cohesive brand presence.

Requirements:
- Experience: Minimum 5 years in digital marketing, with at least 2 years in a leadership or managerial role.
- Core Expertise: Proven track record in hands-on execution and management of Performance Ads (Meta/Google), CRM (Klaviyo/Mailchimp), and SEO.
- Industry Background: Previous experience in a fast-paced agency environment, ideally with exposure to Fintech, Proprietary Trading, or Financial Services.
- Technical Proficiency: Mastery of Google Analytics (GA4), Meta Ads Manager, SEMrush/Ahrefs, and CRM automation tools.
- Analytical Mindset: Strong ability to manage budgets, analyze market trends, and deliver measurable growth targets.
- Language: Professional-level English (written and verbal) for international team and client collaboration.
- Location: Willing to work in a Hybrid setup in Jakarta or Bali.

title: Product Designer
description_text:
Founded to transform retail finance, Ajaib Group is an Indonesian fintech unicorn breaking barriers to financial access. Having recently secured a $270M Series C—the single largest funding round in Southeast Asia over the past four years—we are backed by premier global investors including Y Combinator, Ribbit Capital, SoftBank, and SBI Holdings.
To build world-class products, we assemble world-class talent. Supported by our fully hybrid work arrangement, our team spans Eastern Europe, the Middle East, India, and Southeast Asia, allowing you to work with brilliant engineers and builders from around the globe from wherever you are.

Role Overview
As a Product Designer at Ajaib, you will play a critical role in shaping and defining the user experience of our innovative financial products. Ajaib is a fast-growing fintech startup in Indonesia, aiming to make stock trading accessible for millennials through our mobile-first approach.
In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Product Managers, Engineers, and fellow Designers, to create intuitive and user-centered designs that align with our brand aesthetic and business goals.

Responsibilities
- Design intuitive, user-centered interfaces and experiences for our mobile and web applications.
- Create wireframes, prototypes, and visual designs from concept to implementation.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, define user flows, and contribute to product strategy and roadmap.
- Conduct user research, usability testing, and iterate designs based on feedback and data analysis.
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices in user interface design and user experience.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field.
- 2+ years of professional experience as a Product Designer, preferably in a tech startup environment.
- Strong portfolio showcasing your design process, user-centered approach, and problem-solving skills.
- Proficiency in design tools such as Sketch, Adobe XD, or Figma.
- Strong understanding of interaction design principles and an eye for visual design.
- Experience conducting user research and usability testing is a plus.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Bonus
- Experience designing for financial or investment-related products.
- Proficiency in prototyping tools such as InVision or Marvel.
- Experience with design systems and component-based design.
- Passion for financial technology and staying up-to-date with market trends.

title: Digital Marketing Manager (BBS829)
description_text:
We're looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to take full ownership of social media and paid advertising for a premier debate and speech education company serving students across Greater China and Southeast Asia. You will develop and execute content strategy, design graphics in Canva, coordinate with in-house video and design staff, run paid campaigns on Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn, and drive the inquiry volume that fills enrollment.
This is an end-to-end ownership role, not a task-execution role. You will identify opportunities, chase down content from coaches and staff, set your own priorities, and build systems that produce consistent results without waiting to be told what to do next. The company has strong programs, a talented in-house creative team, and a clear market. What it needs is someone who can translate that into digital engagement and measurable inquiries across the Asian education market. If you thrive on autonomy, take pride in building things from scratch, and are motivated by seeing your work drive real enrollment conversions, this role is a strong fit.
Why You'll Want to Join
- You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
- Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
- Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
- 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
- This role requires availability Tuesday through Saturday, 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM Hong Kong Time — this schedule is non-negotiable given the need for real-time coordination with the Asia-based team and audience during peak engagement hours
- Own the full digital marketing function for an established education brand with a strong reputation across Greater China and Southeast Asia
- High-autonomy role with direct ownership over strategy, execution, and results

What You'll Work On
Content Strategy and Execution
- Audit current social channels and develop an ambitious growth strategy focused on generating inquiries and boosting engagement across Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn
- Generate fresh, high-converting content ideas tailored to parents and students in the target markets, with a clear understanding of what drives families to inquire about extracurricular education services
- Serve as the primary project manager for content production — proactively chase coaches, staff, and students for raw footage, photos, testimonials, and program updates without waiting for content to come to you
- Manage the content calendar and execute all posting and scheduling aligned with Hong Kong Time peak engagement windows
Graphic Asset Creation and Post-Production Coordination
- Design static graphics independently in Canva for ads, carousels, stories, and promotional materials — this is a core hands-on responsibility
- Brief and coordinate with the in-house video editing team for all video post-production needs, providing clear creative direction, assets, and deadlines
- Collaborate with the in-house graphic designer for complex branding assets, providing clear briefs and managing timelines
Paid Advertising and Community Management
- Plan, launch, and optimize paid ad campaigns on Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn with a strict focus on cost per inquiry and enrollment conversion
- Monitor engagement, respond to DMs and comments during core hours, and track analytics weekly to refine strategy toward inquiry generation
- Translate educational value propositions into compelling marketing copy that resonates with families in the target markets
Cross-Functional Coordination
- Liaise with the marketing and post-production team to ensure all deliverables meet deadlines
- Participate in daily async check-ins and weekly strategy syncs and over-communicate progress and blockers during core hours
- Build repeatable workflows and systems that reduce dependency on manual oversight over time
What You Bring
- Proven track record of owning digital marketing end to end with a portfolio or case studies showing where you identified a gap, built a solution, and drove measurable results with minimal direction
- Deep understanding of Greater China and Southeast Asian education markets including Hong Kong, Singapore, and Mainland China, and how families in these regions evaluate extracurricular education services
- Demonstrated success running paid campaigns and growing organic engagement on Facebook and Instagram targeting Asian education audiences
- Experience coordinating with subject matter experts to extract content — comfortable following up persistently and professionally to get what you need
- Strong Canva proficiency for creating polished, on-brand static graphics independently — video editing skills are not required
- Inquiry-focused mindset with a genuine obsession over conversion metrics rather than vanity metrics
- Strong written English with the ability to adapt tone for both students and parents in the target markets
- Mandarin or Cantonese proficiency is highly valued for authentic market connection
Nice to Have
- Background in education, tutoring, enrichment, or service-based industries
- Experience with WeChat, Rednote (Xiaohongshu), or other regional platforms
- Experience with CRM integration and lead tracking in Asian markets
- Existing network or community connections in Hong Kong, China, or Singapore education circles
How to Apply
Please include:
- Your updated resume
- A portfolio link or case studies showing digital marketing work you have owned including paid campaigns, content strategy, or social growth results — ideally with evidence of inquiry or conversion outcomes
- A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your experience marketing to Asian education audiences, and walking through one campaign or content initiative you owned end to end and the results it produced
Only candidates who submit both a portfolio and Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.
If you are a self-directed digital marketer who understands the Asian education market, can build systems that generate consistent inquiries, and want full ownership over strategy and execution for a brand with a strong product and a clear market, this role gives you the autonomy and the direct impact to do your best work.
Application Process Overview
Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:
1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team
Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.
We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

title: Sales Representative (Digital Marketing Agency)
description_text:
IBMC is assisting a global Digital Marketing Agency in expanding its international footprint. Our client specializes in high-impact growth strategies, brand positioning, and performance marketing for a worldwide audience. We are looking for a proactive sales professional who understands the agency landscape and thrives on driving high-value conversions.
As a Sales Representative, you will be the bridge between our agency’s creative solutions and global brands looking for growth. You will identify and nurture relationships with businesses across various time zones, acting as a consultative partner who can translate marketing services into business ROI.

Key Responsibilities
- Global Outreach: Execute multi-channel outreach strategies via Email, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp to engage with potential clients and global brands.
- Lead Qualification: Initiate rapport-building conversations and conduct discovery calls to qualify leads for the agency’s service pipeline.
- Meeting Generation: Consistently achieve monthly targets for booking qualified sales meetings and project consultations for the Creative & Strategy teams.
- Pipeline Management: Meticulously track all lead activities, follow-ups, and status updates using CRM tools (HubSpot/Pipedrive).
- Consultative Selling: Present marketing services (SEO, SEM, Social Media, Branding) in a clear, persuasive manner tailored to the specific growth needs of the client.
- Objection Handling: Confidently navigate commercial objections and competitive comparisons to move deals forward through the funnel.
- Market Insights: Provide regular performance feedback and market trends to the leadership team to optimize outreach scripts and service offerings.

Requirements:
- Experience: Minimum 2 years of proven experience in B2B Sales, Business Development, or Account Management (Strictly no fresh graduates).
- Agency DNA: Previous experience working within a Marketing Agency or selling Digital Services is highly preferred.
- Global Outreach: Proven track record in reaching out to and winning clients outside of Indonesia (Global/International market).
- Global Mindset: Comfortable and capable of working across multiple time zones (EU, APAC, or US) to meet global client availability.
- Language Proficiency: Exceptional English communication skills (both written and verbal) for interacting with international stakeholders and decision-makers.
- CRM Mastery: Hands-on experience with CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive.
- Sales DNA: Self-motivated, target-driven, and resilient with a hunger for identifying new business opportunities.
- Professionalism: Ability to maintain a high level of responsiveness and a professional "brand voice" in all client communications.

title: Corporate Sales & Marketing Specialist ǀ Riverside Golf Club
description_text:
Role Purpose:
The Corporate Sales & Marketing Specialist is responsible for driving growth by promoting the company's products and services to other businesses or within the golf industry. This role involves understanding the needs of business clients, building partnerships, and creating targeted Corporate Sales strategies.

Key Responsibilities:
Developing & Execute B2B Sales & Marketing Strategies:
- Strengthen the corporate sales position in the market.
- Create and execute sales plans tailored to businesses in the golf sector, emphasizing the company’s value proposition.
- Define key Sales objectives and track metrics to measure the success of campaigns
- Collaborate with Marketing teams to create events, promotional materials, presentations, and proposals that align with the needs of business clients.
Market Research and Analysis:
- Conduct market research to understand the trends, demands, and challenges within the golf industry.
- Identify potential business clients (golf clubs, resorts, tournament organizers, corporate sponsors, golf course designers, equipment suppliers).
- Analyze competitor strategies and market positioning to develop competitive marketing approaches.
Lead Generation and Management:
- Generate high-quality business leads through networking, trade shows, and digital channels (LinkedIn, email marketing, industry forums).
- Develop partnerships with golf equipment suppliers, service providers, and sponsors.
- Nurture business relationships and follow up with prospects to convert leads into clients.
Event Management and Trade Shows:
- Organize and participate in industry events, trade shows, and golf tournaments to promote the company’s offerings.
- Coordinate sponsorship opportunities and partnerships that increase brand visibility within the B2B sector.
Sales Management:
- Work closely with the Markketing team to align with sales goals and develop strategies that support business growth.
- Responsible in the creation of sales materials and presentations for business pitches.
Sales Reporting & CRM Management:
- Track sales progress, leads, and opportunities using a CRM system and maintain detailed records of interactions with clients.
- Provide regular updates and reports on sales performance, pipeline status, and market insights to senior management.
- Set up meetings, follow-up calls, and outreach as necessary to maximize client engagement.

Requirements:
- Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field – A foundational understanding of marketing principles is essential.
- Additional Certifications:
- Certifications in digital marketing, content marketing, or B2B marketing (such as Google Ads, HubSpot, or LinkedIn certifications) can be a plus.
- Industry-specific knowledge in golf or sports management could be advantageous.
- Very good English speaking and writing.
- Smart and proactive in nature.
Experience :
- Experience in the golf industry is a must (essential).
- 3-5 years of experience in B2B Sales marketing or a similar role
- Prior experience in developing and executing B2B sales marketing strategies.
- Proven ability to work with businesses such as golf clubs, resorts, golf equipment suppliers, or other golf service providers.
- Experience in driving and managing B2B marketing campaigns that generate leads and close deals.
- Knowledge of the golf industry, including the needs and challenges faced by golf-related businesses, will set a candidate apart.
- A strong network within the big corporation or the golf industry ( related sports industries) can be highly beneficial for building business relationships and partnerships.
- Able to think creatively and develop innovative strategies to target and engage B2B clients in a competitive market.

title: Paid Ads & Performance Marketing Manager (BBS869)
description_text:
We're looking for a Paid Ads & Performance Marketing Manager to own paid media strategy and execution across Meta, Google, TikTok, and Amazon for the Australian market of a well-established clinical skincare brand with a global DTC and retail presence. You will replace an existing agency, take full ownership of paid channel performance, diagnose what is missing strategically, and drive D2C growth back into high gear working directly with the brand's digital and communications team.
This is not an execution-only role. You will own the strategy as well as the management, identifying gaps in funnel mix, retargeting, and upper and lower funnel balance, and directing what needs to change. Creative assets come from an in-house designer based on your briefs. If you have hands-on Meta ads experience, a data-driven growth mindset, and prefer the ownership and visibility of an in-house role over the siloed structure of an agency, this role is a strong fit.
Why You'll Want to Join
- You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
- Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
- Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
- 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
- This role requires meaningful overlap with Australian business hours
- Own the full paid media function for the Australian market of a globally recognized skincare brand
- High-ownership performance marketing role with direct impact on D2C revenue and brand growth
What You'll Work On
Paid Media Strategy and Platform Ownership
- Own strategy and hands-on management across Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google, TikTok, and Amazon ads for the Australian market
- Diagnose gaps in the current paid media strategy including retargeting coverage, funnel mix, and upper and lower funnel balance
- Direct what needs to change and implement improvements with speed and clarity
- Manage a significant annual paid media budget with full accountability for performance and spend efficiency
Creative Briefing and Asset Direction
- Identify creative needs based on strategic priorities and brief the in-house designer accordingly
- Ensure creative assets align with platform best practices and campaign objectives
- Test creative hypotheses and iterate based on performance data
Performance Analysis and Reporting
- Monitor campaign performance across all platforms and surface actionable insights regularly
- Track key metrics including ROAS, CAC, CTR, conversion rate, and revenue contribution by channel
- Communicate performance clearly to the digital and communications team with recommended next steps
- Stay current on platform updates, algorithm changes, and emerging AI ad tools that could improve performance
What You Bring
- Proven hands-on Meta and Facebook ads experience; this is the primary hard requirement for this role
- Experience managing paid media in-house at an e-commerce brand of similar scale and spend level; in-house brand experience is preferred over agency-only backgrounds given the tendency for agency roles to be siloed by platform
- Comfortable owning paid media strategy end to end including diagnosing gaps, setting direction, and executing changes independently
- Data-driven and growth-minded with the ability to pick up a new market and brand quickly
- Experience managing significant ad budgets with clear accountability for performance outcomes
- Strong written and verbal English communication skills for briefing creative, reporting to stakeholders, and collaborating with a distributed team
- Meaningful overlap with Australian business hours
Nice to Have
- Experience across Google, TikTok, and Amazon ads alongside Meta
- Familiarity with emerging AI ad platforms and tools
- Background in beauty, skincare, wellness, or consumer DTC brands
- Experience transitioning a brand from agency-managed to in-house paid media management
How to Apply
Please include:
- Your updated resume
- A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your paid media experience including platforms managed and budget scale, and explaining how you would approach diagnosing a brand's underperforming paid ads program in a new market
Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short homework assignment, a mini audit of an existing paid ads account to assess strategic thinking and platform fluency.
Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.
If you are a data-driven performance marketer who thrives with full ownership, knows how to diagnose and fix a paid media strategy rather than just execute one, and wants to drive D2C growth for a well-established global skincare brand, this role gives you the budget, the access, and the direct impact to do your best work.
Application Process Overview
Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:
- Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
- Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
- Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
- Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
- Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
- Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
- Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
- Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team
Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.
We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

title: Video Editor (Long and Short-Form) for a Performance Marketing Agency (Remote)
description_text:
About us
Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that specializes in pairing remote work with top-tier talent!
We are dedicated to connecting talented individuals with remarkable companies in need of their skills. Our goal is to create fulfilling job opportunities for professionals around the world.
About the Role
What you'll do
Short-form editing (TikTok, Reels, Shorts, Facebook)
- Edit a high volume of vertical short-form videos (roughly 30–90 seconds) built to stop the scroll in the first 1–3 seconds.
- Cut for each platform's native style: pacing, captions, safe zones, aspect ratios, trending audio and formats.
- Turn raw footage, founder content, creator clips and transformation shoots into multiple hook and format variations per concept.
- Repurpose long-form episodes into clips, carousels-to-video and cutdowns without losing the story.
Long-form editing (YouTube and Facebook)
- Edit 8–30+ minute YouTube videos with strong story structure, retention-driven pacing, B-roll, music and sound design.
- Build intros, chapter breaks, lower thirds and end screens that keep viewers watching.
- Collaborate on thumbnails and titles with an eye on click-through and retention.
Motion graphics and AI generation
- Create motion graphics, animated text, transitions and branded templates in After Effects.
- Stay current on new AI video tools and pitch ways to use them to ship faster or try new formats.
Workflow and ownership
- Own projects from brief to delivery: organize footage, edit, self-QA, export platform-ready files and hand off on time.
- Maintain and improve our editing systems: project templates, file naming, folder structures, presets, LUTs, caption styles and export settings.
- Track work in our project management tool (ClickUp), updating status as each piece moves through the pipeline.
- Turn around revisions quickly and fold feedback into future edits without being told twice.
How we work
- Fully remote, async-first. Briefs, footage and feedback live in shared drives, Frame.io and ClickUp, so work keeps moving across time zones.
- Daily overlap. A short daily check-in during your overlap window with Pacific Time, plus written updates on what shipped and what's blocked.
- Turnaround expectations. Short-form edits typically delivered within 24 hours of brief; revisions within one business day; long-form on an agreed schedule.
- Volume. Expect a steady weekly output across short- and long-form. [15–25 short-form + 1–2 long-form per week.]

Requirements:
What you bring
Must-haves
- 3+ years of professional video editing, with a portfolio showing both short-form and long-form work.
- Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects..
- Hands-on experience generating video with Higgsfield AI, with examples of AI-generated or AI-assisted footage used in finished edits.
- Proven experience editing for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, and a clear understanding of how each platform's content differs.
- A fast, repeatable workflow: you can show how you organize projects, use templates and presets, and ship multiple finished pieces per day.
- Strong instinct for hooks, pacing, story and sound; you know why one edit holds attention and another doesn't.
- Clear written English for async communication, briefs and feedback.
- Reliable high-speed internet, a capable editing machine and your own Adobe Creative Cloud license.
- At least 4 hours of daily overlap with Pacific Time (PT) for check-ins and fast revisions.
Nice-to-haves
- Experience with other AI tools (Runway, Kling, Veo, ElevenLabs, CapCut AI features, Topaz).
- Experience with brand, DTC, beauty, wellness or transformation/before-and-after content.
- Thumbnail design skills for YouTube.
- Familiarity with DaVinci Resolve for color grading.
- Comfort reading organic analytics (retention curves, watch time, saves, shares) and editing toward them.
- Experience with Frame.io and ClickUp or similar review and project tools.
- Use Higgsfield AI to generate and extend shots, B-roll, product visuals, scene transitions and stylized effects that would be slow or costly to film.

title: Marketing Executive - MAKE UP FOR EVER

title: IFRS17 Accounting Senior Specialist
description_text:
Job Description:
1. Prepare recurring accounting and financial reporting deliverables.
Complete assigned IFRS 17/PSAK 117 accounting entries, closing schedules, supporting analyses, and financial reporting packages in accordance with the established reporting calendar. Validate the completeness and accuracy of source data and outputs, ensure consistency with accounting policies and prior-period reporting, obtain the required review or approval, and submit final deliverables to relevant local and regional stakeholders within agreed timelines.

2. Prepare and maintain account reconciliations.
Reconcile assigned general ledger balances and IFRS 17 reporting outputs to relevant sub-ledgers, actuarial results, system reports, or other supporting records. Investigate reconciling items, unusual movements, and period-on-period variances; document the analysis and root cause; discuss findings with relevant teams; and monitor agreed adjustments or corrective actions through timely resolution.

3. Perform assigned financial control activities over accounting data and reporting. Execute and document controls are designed to confirm the completeness, accuracy, authorization, and traceability of accounting data, journal entries, reconciliations, and reporting outputs. Retain appropriate evidence of control performance, identify exceptions or control gaps, assess their potential reporting impact, and coordinate with relevant data, system, accounting, or process owners to support remediation and prevent recurrence.

4. Support external audit requirements related to IFRS 17.
Prepare accurate, complete, and audit-ready working papers, account analyses, reconciliations, movement explanations, control evidence, and other supporting documentation. Coordinate the timely provision of requested information, respond to audit queries in collaboration with relevant stakeholders, maintain a clear audit trail, and follow up on outstanding requests or findings until closure.

5. Coordinate resolution of IFRS 17 accounting and reporting issues.
Work with Accounting, Actuarial, Regional, Technology, and other relevant stakeholders to clarify requirements, assess accounting or reporting implications, identify root causes, and agree practical corrective actions. Maintain visibility of key issues, owners, dependencies, and target dates; follow up on progress; communicate risks or delays; and escalate material or unresolved matters to the IFRS 17 & Project Lead to support timely and accurate delivery.

6. Monitor monthly balance sheet accounts reconciliations and aging.
Track the timely completion and review of monthly balance sheet account reconciliations, monitor the aging of outstanding reconciling items, follow up with relevant account owners on overdue or long-outstanding items, and escalate significant issues to support timely resolution and maintain balance sheet integrity.

Requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in accounting.
• Minimum 4-5 years of experience in accounting or financial reporting within the insurance industry or a public accounting firm.
• Familiarity with IFRS 17/PSAK 117, or prior exposure to related accounting and reporting processes.
• Good understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting, reconciliations, and financial controls.
• Fluent in written and spoken English.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with other departments and regional stakeholders.

title: IT GRC Analyst
description_text:
Xendit is the financial technology platform built for businesses that move fast. We give companies one unified platform for payment acceptance, payouts, treasury and financial services, replacing fragmented local integrations with a single infrastructure layer. We serve businesses of every size, from high-growth startups to global enterprises, processing high-volume transactions across Southeast Asia and beyond, with more markets on our global expansion roadmap.
About the Job

At Xendit, we are looking for a mid-level/senior-level IT GRC Analyst to sit at the intersection of technology, compliance, and risk — not just for Indonesia, but across all of Xendit's operating markets. As an individual contributor, you will be responsible for ensuring our IT systems, processes, and controls meet the regulatory obligations and certification standards of every jurisdiction we operate in. You will be our regional GRC go-to person, coordinating directly with regulatory bodies across the regions (Bank Indonesia / OJK, BSP, BOT, etc). Beyond regulatory compliance, you will own and drive the full lifecycle of our IT certifications such as PCI-DSS and ISO 27001. You will work closely with engineering, security, product, and legal teams to embed compliance into how we build and operate. This is a role for someone who is detail-oriented, thrives in multi-market complexity, and can translate a wide range of regulatory requirements into practical, actionable controls in a fast-moving fintech environment.

Minimum Qualifications

- 3–5 years of hands-on experience in IT GRC, IT Risk Management, or IT Compliance roles

- Solid working knowledge of PCI-DSS, ISO 27001 frameworks, including implementation, certification, and audit readiness

- Familiarity with Bank Indonesia (BI) and OJK IT governance regulations applicable to payment service providers in Indonesia

- Exposure to or willingness to take regulatory requirements in at least one other Southeast Asian or international market (e.g., BSP, BOT, MAS, BNM, or equivalent)

- Proven experience conducting IT risk assessments, control testing, and gap analyses

- Demonstrated ability to develop, review, and maintain IT policies, standards, and procedures

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate diverse regulatory requirements into technical and operational controls

- Effective communicator who can engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders across multiple countries and time zones

Preferred Qualifications

- Prior experience navigating Bank Indonesia's PJP (Penyelenggara Jasa Pembayaran) Category 1 or Category 2 licensing requirements, including ongoing IT compliance obligations and regulatory examination readiness

- Hands-on experience managing end-to-end certification processes — scoping, readiness assessment, evidence preparation, auditor coordination, and post-certification surveillance — for ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, or SOC 2

- Direct experience coordinating IT audits or regulatory examinations with regional bodies such as BSP (Philippines), BOT (Thailand), MAS (Singapore), BNM (Malaysia), etc

- Relevant professional certifications such as CISA, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor

- Prior experience in fintech, digital payments, or financial services in a multi-market Southeast Asian or global context

- Exposure to cloud environments and understanding of cloud security control frameworks

- Background in working cross-functionally with engineering and product teams to embed compliance-by-design principles

Responsibilities

- Own and support Xendit's compliance programs for certification and regulatory audits, ensuring controls are implemented, tested, and evidenced effectively

- Serve as the primary GRC point of contact for regional regulatory needs, coordinating IT-related audit and examination processes with regional regulatory bodies

- Manage the full certification lifecycle for applicable frameworks — from initial scoping and gap analysis through certification issuance and ongoing surveillance — ensuring timely renewals and continuous compliance

- Conduct periodic IT risk assessments across markets, maintain a consolidated IT risk register, and track remediation activities through to closure

- Perform internal control testing and assessments to evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of IT controls across Xendit's regional entities

- Identify compliance gaps across markets and work with relevant teams to develop and execute remediation plans

- Develop, review, update, and enforce IT policies, standards, and procedures in line with multi-jurisdictional regulatory and framework requirements

- Coordinate regulatory and third-party audits end-to-end, including preparing evidence packages, managing auditor requests, and facilitating examiner meetings

- Monitor the evolving regulatory landscape across all operating markets and assess the impact of new or updated requirements on Xendit's IT environment

- Produce compliance dashboards, regional status reports, and management briefings to keep stakeholders informed of GRC posture across all markets

- Collaborate with engineering, product, security, and legal teams to embed compliance and risk considerations into project delivery and system design

- Support continuous improvement of GRC processes, tooling, and automation to scale compliance operations efficiently across a growing number of markets

title: Senior Design System and Product Designer - Operational Journey
description_text:
Xendit is the financial technology platform built for businesses that move fast. We give companies one unified platform for payment acceptance, payouts, treasury and financial services, replacing fragmented local integrations with a single infrastructure layer. We serve businesses of every size, from high-growth startups to global enterprises, processing high-volume transactions across Southeast Asia and beyond, with more markets on our global expansion roadmap.
Why this role exists

The merchant lifecycle: onboarding, activation, and lifecycle across many surfaces, where consistency and reusability matter as much as any single flow. This role does double duty: raise the craft on the merchant lifecycle experience, and own the design system that keeps that experience coherent as the domain scales. You are the person who both designs the hard flow and builds the pattern that keeps the next ten from drifting.

What you'll own

- Product design in the Operational Journey cluster: onboarding, dashboard, and KYC-heavy lifecycle flow, reconciling clarity with compliance requirements.

- Design system consolidation (your first mission): take the existing design system, analyze and diagnose it, consolidate and document it properly, and establish tokens and patterns the whole team can build on.

- Design standards across the domain: you set the quality bar and guide design decisions in areas without a dedicated designer yet, including the developer-experience surface, through standards and critique, not by producing every screen.

- Mentorship: you raise the craft of other designers on the team when needed.

How you will work

You report to the Product Design & UX Director for Customer Lifecycle. You are the senior design owner in the domain at the outset, setting standards, shipping craft, and building the system others rely on. Your time splits between product work and system consolidation, weighted toward the system early while the foundation is built, then rebalancing toward product. The domain works from validated findings rather than assumptions and values direct, candid critique.

What we're looking for

In priority order:

- Product design craft, first and foremost. An excellent product designer with a portfolio that shows depth, complex flows made genuinely simple, decisions grounded in user problems rather than decoration. This is the primary bar.

- Systems thinking you can demonstrate. You have built reusable components, tokens, and patterns with rigor, thinking about consistency, versioning, and how others will use what you make. You need not have single-handedly rebuilt a legacy system, but you should show the instinct and the mechanics.

- Fluency with the discipline of disclosure. In regulated products, design is often the instrument of compliance, communicating required information so users genuinely understand it. Experience with this kind of high-stakes clarity is a strong signal.

A strong plus: consolidating or migrating an existing design system; fintech or payments product design; front-end literacy; a track record of mentoring designers up.

location: Bangkok, Thailand; Jakarta, Indonesia; Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia; Manila, Philippines; Singapore, Singapore
description_text:
Xendit is the financial technology platform built for businesses that move fast. This domain runs on trade-offs, experience versus compliance, merchant versus developer, and those decisions are better made with evidence than with opinion. This role owns generative and evaluative research across the merchant lifecycle and the developer experience, and makes research a standing input to how the domain prioritizes rather than an occasional favor.

What you'll own

- The research roadmap across the domain's three clusters, prioritized against the decisions that most need evidence.

- Mixed methods: interviews, usability testing, surveys, and behavioral/funnel analysis in partnership with Data.

You report to the Product Design & UX Director for Customer Lifecycle and work across all three clusters, partnering with the PMs and designers who rely on your evidence to prioritize. Much of your impact comes through influence rather than mandate, moving decisions with evidence. The domain works from validated findings rather than assumptions and values direct, candid critique.

What we're looking for

- Mixed-methods UX research experience. You are fluent across qualitative and quantitative approaches.

- The ability to translate findings into product decisions and to influence without authority.

title: Senior Security Engineer, Cyber Defense (Threat Detection)
description_text:
Life at Grab
At Grab, every Grabber is guided by The Grab Way, which spells out our mission, how we believe we can achieve it, and our operating principles - the 4Hs: Heart, Hunger, Honour, and Humility. These principles guide and help us make decisions as we work to create economic empowerment for the people of Southeast Asia.

Get to Know the Team
You’ll be part of an exciting team responsible for the Grab Cyber Defence with the core mission of defending Grab and Grabbers from external and internal threat actors. We do this by detecting, hunting, and responding to those threat actors. Cyber Defence continuously prepares by emulating threat actors to test and practice our defenses. Based on our work and data we collect, we provide insights to our key stakeholders on current and future threats to Grab.
Get to Know the Role
You should have 3-5 or more years in a Security Operations Centre where you have strong security operations analytical skills and understand alerts generated by Cyber Security tools and mentored and assisted junior team members. Alternatively, you may have very strong Cyber Security domain knowledge in Pen-testing, Red-team, Digital Forensics, Cyber Threat Intelligence, or similar experience and looking for a slight shift.
As a Grab Senior Threat Detection Engineer, your core responsibilities are triaging and finding ways to reduce the mean time to detection and containment of a threat before it becomes a larger threat to Grab. You would be helping the junior and team leads understand and triage alerts as well. You are confident in reaching out to Grabbers directly at all seniority levels and cultures, to determine if an action was a threat to Grab.
You would have improved Security Operations in your previous roles by reducing false positives, and creating new alert criteria. You may have done some automation already (SOAR, scripting or engineering) or have good ideas on how to operate in a large-scale and complex environment. You have helped out or maybe lead incidents and can work independently given a task. Malware and analysis of obfuscated scripts may have been something you are highly proficient at.
You want to participate in threat hunting and purple team engagements to improve Cyber Defence core mission.
You’ll be surrounded by equally driven and passionate individuals and supported via training and given time to learn.
The Day-to-Day Activities:
-
Review Cyber Security alerts evaluate their severity and escalate as required.
-
Review alert criteria for host and network intrusions and push them to production. Also produce decision criteria and playbooks for alerts, automating as much as possible.
-
Mature existing detection rules, and create automated tests and automation workflows to improve the overall detection capability.
-
Contribute to identifying gaps in the current logging and detection capability and suggest mechanisms to remediate these gaps.
-
Contribute to threat hunting, purple team efforts searching for unknown malicious activity in our network using the latest threat intel and knowledge of Cyber security.
-
Respond with the team when an incident occurs, you will be on the front lines of response for the entire company.
-
Contribute to engaging the overall Grab team, working collaboratively to address Grab’s security challenges while understanding business needs.
Our Commitment
We recognize that with these individual attributes come different workplace challenges, and we will work with Grabbers to address them in our journey towards creating inclusion at Grab for all Grabbers.

The Must-Haves:
-
3-5 years of experience in a Security Operations Centre or worked as a Pentester, Red-teamer, Cyber Threat Intelligence, Digital Forensics or Incident Response who wants to make a slight shift.
-
Ability to work on an on-call basis in a rotating roster.
-
Some experience working with SIEM.
-
Some experience conducting triaging and escalation in a Cyber Security Operations environment.
-
Knowledge of frameworks such as ATT&CK and kill-chain and good communication skills.
-
Willingness to work in a regional role covering multiple cultures and countries
-
Working collaboratively with other team members.
-
Strong, proven track record of delivering results in fast-paced, resource-scarce environments. Assume your favorite tool is not available but that you have the chance to learn a new one.
-
Ability to handle stress effectively and maintain strong output during triage or incidents.
-
Curiosity and a relentless drive to understand how complex IT environments work and how detections can be built.
-
Participated in Incident Response in complex corporate environments.
-
Experience with multiple security tools/systems/logs (network, EDR, WAF, OS etc.)
-
Some scripting ability to automate tasks or process large amounts of unstructured data.
-
Developing security rules in a SIEM platform

The Nice-to-Haves
-
Some Cloud knowledge, CI/CD pipelines, Containerisation, and bringing a Cyber Security mindset to the mix.
-
Relevant industry certifications
-
Cyber Security: SANS GCIH, GMON, GCIA, GCFA, SIEM, etc.;
-
Cloud infrastructure: (AWS, Azure, GCP).
-
Developing security rules in a SIEM platform, workflows in a SOAR platform, and working knowledge of cloud platforms.

title: Education Marketing Specialist - Indonesia (6-month contract)
description_text:
Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.
Kamusta, hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, สวัสดี!
Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
Where and how you can work
Alongside our global campuses, we also collaborate with talented contractors and freelancers from all over the world to help us achieve our crazy big goals. While we support flexible, remote-friendly ways of working, for this role we’re focusing on Jakarta, Indonesia so we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing.
This role is a 6-month engagement, working 40 hours per week.
What you’d be doing in this role
As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.
As an Education Marketing Specialist, you will sit at the centre of campaign execution, turning strategy into action. You will collaborate with the Education team, PerMar, Community, Social, agency partners, and cross-functional teams to bring high-impact campaigns to life.
Your work will directly shape how millions of teachers and students experience Canva in their classrooms, empowering them to achieve stronger teaching and learning outcomes.
At the moment, this role is focused on:
- Deliver end-to-end execution of truly local education marketing campaigns from initiation and briefing to rollout and performance reporting, ensuring campaigns launch smoothly, resonate with Indonesian teachers and students, and measurably contribute to deeper classroom usage.
- Develop insight-led campaign briefs, translating strategic goals into structured execution plans that drive activation and support long-term usage.
- Coordinate assets across internal teams and agency partners, maintaining clear timelines and quality standards so campaigns are delivered on time, on brand, and at a consistently high bar, strengthening trust, operational efficiency, and repeatability.
- Execute multi-channel campaigns across email, social, influencer, paid, and in-product surfaces, optimising channel mix and messaging to expand reach, increase engagement, and convert awareness into meaningful classroom usage among teachers and students.
- Localise global messages into culturally relevant education narratives, ensuring campaigns feel native to Indonesian classrooms rather than translated, increasing relevance, shareability, and impact across diverse education audiences.
- Track and analyse performance metrics beyond vanity numbers, connecting campaign activity to activation signals, student engagement, and Education MAU contribution, and providing clear, insight-led recommendations for improvement.
- Identify optimisation opportunities and continuously iterate campaigns, applying structured learnings to improve performance over time and raise the execution bar quarter by quarter.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with Education Sales, Community, Product Marketing, and broader Marketing teams, ensuring cohesive messaging and coordinated activation that reinforces adoption, strengthens ecosystem alignment, and drives sustained classroom impact.
You're probably a match if
- You have deep experience in the Indonesian education market, especially K–12. You understand how teachers and students use digital tools in real classroom settings, and you know how to design campaigns that align with school calendars, assessment cycles, and institutional realities — driving meaningful learning outcomes, not just surface-level engagement.
- You’ve run end-to-end campaigns targeting teachers and/or students. You confidently move from insight to brief, coordination to launch, and reporting to iteration — ensuring your campaigns drive reach, activation, and sustained usage.
- You know how to localise global ideas into culturally relevant stories for Indonesian education audiences. You understand tone, channel behaviour, and what motivates teachers versus students — and you tailor your messaging accordingly.
- You’re a clear and compelling communicator. You simplify complex ideas, write strong briefs, present campaign results with structure and purpose, and align stakeholders through thoughtful storytelling.
- You understand how to activate and engage education communities across multiple channels — including email, social, influencer partnerships, and in-product messaging. You know how communities behave online and how to build momentum beyond a single campaign moment.
- You’re data-driven and impact-focused. You look beyond vanity metrics, connecting reach and engagement to activation signals, usage behaviour, and MAU contribution — and you use insights to continuously refine strategy and execution.
- You’re highly organised and operationally disciplined. You proactively manage timelines, dependencies, and risks, anticipating blockers early and delivering campaigns to a high bar.
- You bring a strong growth mindset and sense of ownership. You’re comfortable operating in ambiguity, learning through iteration, raising the execution bar over time, and taking accountability for outcomes.
- You collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners. You build trust through clarity, reliability, and strong communication, ensuring alignment and smooth execution across multiple stakeholders.

About the team
The Indonesia Education Vertical drives end-to-end education growth. Our mission is to expand Canva’s meaningful classroom usage across K–12 and Higher Education.
We work closely with the Ministry of Education, local education stakeholders, community leaders, and internal cross-functional teams to ensure Canva becomes embedded in everyday teaching and learning.
Other stuff to know
We make hiring decisions to engage contractors based on your experience, skills and passion. When you signify interest in the Project, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the contractor-accreditation interview process.
Please note that contractor-accreditation meetings are conducted virtually.
We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above - we still want to hear from you!
Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

title: Senior Data Scientist - Lending
description_text:
About the Role
 
In this role, you will be an integral player within Data Science team based on Jakarta. You will take the wheel in building, evaluating, and monitoring credit risk models for a variety of consumer and merchant lending products GoPay offers in Indonesia. Your responsibilities will include enhancing our credit risk models by leveraging innovative and cutting-edge algorithms on GoTo data and third-party data vendors. Most importantly, your efforts will work to bring wider financial inclusion to more people in the region and beyond.


What You Will Do:
- Drive End-to-End Impact: Take complete ownership of the machine learning lifecycle. You will conceptualize, build, deploy, and monitor data models that directly influence key business metrics and bottom-line results.

- Innovate Credit Risk Strategy: Lead the development of advanced consumer credit risk models. Apply rigorous statistical analysis and ML techniques to optimize lending decisions, balance risk, and fuel sustainable business growth.

- Partner with Product & Business: Act as a strategic bridge between data and business strategy. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to translate ambiguous business challenges into scalable, production-ready data science solutions.

- Champion Technical Excellence: Set the standard for robust model evaluation and clear documentation. You will advocate for data science best practices and distill complex technical concepts into actionable insights for non-technical leadership.

What You Will Need:
- Bachelor degree or above in science and engineering related majors such as statistics, mathematics, physics, computer science, etc.

- At least 3 years of hands-on experience in building, evaluating, and monitoring credit risk models.

- Excellent understanding of machine learning techniques and algorithms.

- Comfortable using Python, SQL, and UNIX Shell.

- Understand business concerns and formulate them as technical problems that can be solved using data and math/stats/ML.

- Self-driven and entrepreneurial with a strong sense of ownership, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

- Good communication skills and ability to present technical concepts to a non-technical audience.

- Able to write model documentation clearly and concisely and support recommendations with research and data.

About the Team
 
Our team leverages big data from the GoTo universe, as well as external data, to build various predictive models to support the risk strategy team in real-time credit underwriting and management of the customer lifecycle Cicil (BNPL) and Pinjam (cash loans) products. As our model scores are key inputs to risk decisioning (e.g. approval/rejection of loans, credit limit adjustments), we are also able to see the direct impact of our models on the business and our customers.
 
We are a growing team and are constantly looking for opportunities to use data science to enhance our credit and fraud risk management capabilities. We are focused on growth and efficiency. We are all about open knowledge sharing and self-improvement. We believe that “Data Science is a team sport.”

title: Senior People Analytics Specialist
description_text:
About the Role
 
GoTo is looking for a Senior People Analytics Specialist who is passionate about turning people data into meaningful insights and better decisions.
In this role, you will bridge the gap between People, Data, and Business, helping leaders understand not just what is happening within our workforce, understanding the “why” behind the numbers, and translating insights into actionable recommendations that shape our people strategy.
If you love diving into data, asking thoughtful questions about workforce trends, and translating numbers into clear narratives that drive talent strategy, this role is for you.


What Will You Do:
- Analyze key workforce metrics (retention, engagement, hiring, diversity, performance) to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities.

- Conduct analysis to uncover root causes behind workforce issues such as attrition spikes and hiring bottlenecks.

- Structure and maintain recurring headcount dashboards and ad-hoc report requests.

- Translate raw talent data into digestible insights, executive summaries, and visual stories for HR Business Partners and business leaders.

- Work closely with HR teams (TA, L&D, Total Rewards) to understand their operational challenges and define data-driven solutions.

- Query and extract data efficiently using SQL and spreadsheets.

- Ensure data privacy, governance, and strict confidentiality when handling sensitive employee information.

- Audit and maintain high data accuracy across human resource information systems (HRIS).

What Will You Need:
-

3-5 years of experience in data analysis, with a strong preference for experience within an HR context (e.g., HR Generalist with strong analytical flair, People Operations Analyst, or Talent Data Analyst).

-

Deep understanding of HR metrics, talent lifecycles, and employee engagement frameworks.

-

Adept in SQL: Ability to write clean queries, joins, and aggregations to extract data from the Data Warehouse.

-

Advanced Spreadsheet Skills: Proficient in Excel or Google Sheets (e.g., INDEX/MATCH, XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, data validation, complex nested formulas).

-

Analytical Approach: Strong diagnostic mindset and curious about the why behind data trends, not just reporting the numbers.

-

Data Storytelling: Ability to present technical data clearly to non-technical stakeholders in a conversational, actionable way.

-

Strong business acumen and ability to connect people insights with business priorities.

-

High level of discretion, empathy, and judgment when handling confidential people data.

About the Team
 
It's an Individual Contributor role, part of the HRIS team. This broader team drives and maintains the People and Culture tools across the department/ function for example, L&D tools, survey tools as well as Workday. Working in this team - your key stakeholders are the PAC leadership team and people business partners. You’ll work very closely with all teams across PAC translating data into meaningful insights so we can identify and manage relevant interventions and generate key reports for the business. This role has access to lost of sensitive information so maturity and trust are important aspect for this role.

title: Finance, Accounting & Reporting
description_text:
This position is responsible for supporting monthly financial reporting and ensuring accurate and timely financial records in accordance with applicable accounting standards and banking regulations. The role works closely with internal teams and external parties to support financial closing, reporting, and regulatory compliance.
 


Job Description::
- Engage in preparations of financial reports for regulator, internal management, and shareholders.

- Collaborate in the monthly financial closing process to ensure the transactions are appropriately recorded.

- Perform analysis on the Company's financial figures.

- Assess implementation of accounting policies and accounting standards compliance.

- Collaborate in the preparation of financial statements.

- Liaise with the other functions or external parties (i.e. auditor, OJK) as required.

- Perform ad-hoc tasks as assigned by the management.

Requirements: :
- 2-4 years of experience in related fields (background from a reputable public accounting firm or bank is a plus).

- Bachelor in Finance/ Accounting/ Banking-related major with min. GPA 3.00 from reputable universities.

- Familiar with accounting standards (especially PSAK 71 & 73) and OJK regulation related

- to banking (Pedoman Antasena, Kualitas Aset, Buku Panduan Akuntansi Perbankan, etc.). Knowledgeable in banking transactions/ activities, including journal entries & financial statements preparation.

- Strong analytical and critical thinking.

- Proactive, adaptable, and keen on continuous learning and development.

- Expert in operating Microsoft office especially Excel function for data processing.

title: Tax Specialist
description_text:
This position plays a key role in managing end-to-end tax processes, including reporting, audits, and restitution. You will ensure full compliance with Indonesian tax regulations, provide strategic tax advice on business transactions, and collaborate with cross-functional teams and external consultants. This role offers an opportunity to grow professionally in a structured environment that values continuous learning and staying up-to-date with evolving tax regulations.


Responsibilities::
- Handles end-to-end tax calculation & deduction for each invoice, tax payment & tax reporting processes, monthly & annual, including tax restitution, tax provisions, tax cases and tax disputes.

- Liaise with tax authority to manage and respond regarding SP2DK, tax audit and other inquiry.

- Reconcile/ prepare equalization and adjustments between General Ledger and tax returns.

- Implement the needed changes from updates in tax laws and regulations.

- Query and send the monthly ebupot to each vendor.

- Maintain and record tax documentation including tax returns, BPN, COD/DGT, SKB, invoices and other tax-related documents.

- Provide tax advisory for company transactions, contracts, and projects.

- Ensure all tax matters are in compliance with the latest tax laws and regulations.

Requirements::
- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Tax or related field.

- 5 years working experience in Tax. Preferably from a tax consultant or financial industry, especially Banking.

- Brevet certification will be a distinct advantage.

- Advanced knowledge and understanding of latest Indonesian tax laws, regulations and tax audit process.

- Experienced with the tax payment and reporting end-to-end process in CoreTax.

- Proactive, strong verbal and written communication skills, attention to detail and well-organized.

title: Business Analyst
description_text:
Are you passionate about solving business problems through process improvement, data, and automation? Do you enjoy turning complex operational challenges into structured solutions that create measurable business impact?

We're looking for an analytical and detail-oriented Business Analyst to join our Business Performance & Transformation (BPT) team. In this role, you'll help assess, standardize, and optimize business processes while supporting automation and continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency and enable scalable growth across ATI.

You'll partner with stakeholders across Operations, Commercial, Technology, and BPT to gather requirements, map current and future-state processes, and build data-driven recommendations that guide business decisions and transformation priorities.

- Partner with stakeholders across Operations, Commercial, Technology, and Business Performance & Transformation (BPT) to facilitate workshops, align priorities, and communicate project progress, risks, and key decisions
- Analyze current-state processes and design standardized future-state processes, reports, templates, and solution recommendations that improve efficiency and scalability
- Develop business cases by evaluating expected benefits, implementation effort, and business impact to support project prioritization and investment decisions
- Drive the successful rollout of proven solutions across multiple operational teams by creating reusable documentation, playbooks, templates, and best practices
- Monitor project outcomes and identify opportunities for continuous improvement, automation, and operational excellence
- Translate complex operational and performance data into clear, structured, and persuasive narratives
- Develop executive-ready presentations for QBRs, client engagements, leadership reviews, and strategic discussions
- Work closely with Operations and BPT teams to extract meaningful business insights from performance data
- Partner with senior stakeholders across Operations, Commercial, BPT, and Executive Leadership
- Act as a thought partner in shaping strategic messaging and executive communication

Is this you?:
- More than 4 years of experience in business analysis, process analysis, or business process improvement, with a proven track record of leading projects from initiation to implementation and delivering measurable business outcomes
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with professional proficiency in English (written and spoken)
- Hands-on experience using at least one Business Intelligence (BI) tool, such as Power BI, Looker, or Tableau, to analyze, model, and visualize data
- Strong analytical, logical, and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail
- Experience documenting business requirements, process maps, workflows, and business cases
- Ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced environment
- Experience with process automation, Business Process Management (BPM), or continuous improvement initiatives
- Understanding of ETL processes, data warehouse concepts, or data transformation
- Experience using project management or collaboration tools such as JIRA
- Exposure to the travel, BPO, consulting, or shared services industry
- Professional certifications such as CBAP, Agile/Scrum, Lean, or Six Sigma
- Previous people management experience
- Deep software engineering or programming expertise
- Exceptional storytelling and narrative structuring ability
- Strong PowerPoint and presentation development capability (non-negotiable)
- Ability to simplify complex operational topics into compelling executive messaging
- Strong commercial awareness and business acumen
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Be Part of ATI's Journey

At ATI Business Group, we bring unparalleled knowledge of the travel and hospitality industry to every aspect of our clients' businesses. Through operational expertise, innovative technology, and exceptional talent, we deliver solutions that optimize operations, elevate customer experiences, and accelerate business growth.

Since 2002, we've grown into a global team of 2,000+ professionals, partnering with leading travel and hospitality organizations worldwide. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, helping businesses scale, adapt, and grow while creating meaningful career opportunities along the way.

Join us and help shape the future of travel and hospitality.

title: AI Speech Tester (Indonesian native speaker - Indonesia regional variant)
description_text:
Company description
Terry Soot Management Group (TSMG) is a field data collection company founded in 2017 in Europe. 
We collect data where automation is not possible. We count features, take pictures, make videos, record speech, and scan areas for every detail you need to make more informed decisions. Our field data collection teams are spread across Europe and North America, ready to accept new challenges.
 
Project overview
We are looking for native speakers to participate in a conversational audio data collection project that supports the development of advanced speech and conversational AI technologies.
 
Participants will take part in natural, unscripted conversations with another participant in their native language. The conversations will be recorded in a controlled acoustic environment and guided by a moderator.
 
The collected audio will be used to help train and improve large-scale speech recognition and conversational AI systems.
 
 
 


Responsibilities:
- Participate in a natural conversation with another participant in your native language

- Discuss one of several suggested general-interest topics provided during the session

- Take part in the conversation for approximately 2 hours

- Attend a short technical setup and equipment check before the recording begins

- Follow the session guidelines and moderator instructions

Each session will include two participants and one moderator.

Requirements:
- Native speaker of the target language

- Comfortable participating in paired conversations

- Able to provide informed consent for participation

- Reliable and able to attend the full session
